explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about the library's own `hankelIdeal`, and Mathlib has no Hankel or rational-normal-curve ideal. The proof chains the generic Mathlib lemma `Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced` with the library's own `quotient_isReduced_iff`. Mathlib's lemma only rewrites "the ideal is radical" as "the quotient ring is reduced". The real content is that the quotient by the Hankel ideal is reduced exactly when R is reduced, and that is the library's own lemma. So the result is not a special case of any single Mathlib declaration. I did not search Mathlib further, because this reason is decisive.
